name: mixed_unarmored_baseline
description: Manual helper for comparing Glock and MP5 baseline sessions against the same unarmored dummy. It keeps the setup repeatable, not authoritative.

steps.name: glock_baseline_unarmored
steps.operatorNote: Capture the unarmored Glock baseline with one recovered shot, one moving shot, and one headshot attempt.

steps.name: mp5_baseline_unarmored
steps.operatorNote: Capture the unarmored MP5 baseline with both a short burst and a longer burst before the headshot attempt.
